newsitem.title: ITALY: Rolo Banca set 1996 dividend at 475 lire.
newsitem.headline: Rolo Banca set 1996 dividend at 475 lire.

text.p: Italy's Rolo Banca 1473 SpA said on Wednesday it is proposing a 1996 dividend of 475 lire per share after a payout of 200 lire per share in 1995.

The bank said in a statement that it will go ahead with a free capital issue of around 100 billion lire worth of shares to increase the share capital to 435.07 billion lire from 334.67 billion lire with three new shares issued for every 10 held.
Earlier this month, Rolo said it had more than doubled its net profit in 1996 to 408 billion lire from 167 billion in 1995, while gross operating profit rose 11 percent to 960 billion lire.
